problems.issue: author round 1: built by worker, gate-clean first try

notes: author round 1 — tangent gates PASS; odd-squares contrast+blank-beat fixes applied

problems.issue: The live readouts — the instruments that carry the whole limit argument — are illegible at phone size: at 360px the 16:9 slope=/h= readouts render ~5-6px tall (2.00 vs 2.02 indistinguishable), tick labels are mush, dots near-invisible, the thin amber secant merges with the green curve as one muddy line until 26.5s, and the final "h → 0" is thin pale grey; in 9:16 the mid-scene algebra fraction line (~8px at 360px) is also too small.
problems.fix: Scale the mono readout block ~2.5x into a fixed HUD slot (deep amber slope / red h per the color-is-meaning rule), thicken dots, ticks and the secant from the start, and render "h → 0" in the red h-color at full weight.

problems.issue: Every scene boundary is a simultaneous full reflow: title swaps while the formula/work block jumps slots (y=x² relocates between s01 and s02; at 47.0→47.5 the d/dx row reflows up ~65px when the lim line exits; 30.5→31.5 swaps title+layout at once) — the eye loses its anchor at each cut (glance-test continuity 6/10).
problems.fix: Freeze fixed slots (title / plot / readout / work row) across scenes and change only their content with short cross-fades; never reposition surviving elements mid-film.

problems.issue: Chronic empty canvas in the back half and in portrait: s05 runs 60-90% empty in 16:9 (18.5s of stacked equations with big margins, left-of-center), s06 recap is 55-90% empty, top-heavy with a dangling reserved slot (9:16 recap equation crammed 25px under the text, left edges misaligned ~30px); in 9:16 the plot is a wide 2:1 box only ~12-25% of frame height with a dead bottom band (15-45% empty) in every scene — the portrait frame is never re-proportioned.
problems.fix: Give 9:16 a taller plot (~45-55% of frame height) and a vertically centered recap block with aligned left edges; in both formats put a small live curve+tangent callback beside the s05 algebra and s06 recap so the ending echoes the spine instead of floating text on paper.

notes: Round 2 by math-critic (vision) — full-res frame forensics on both drafts + the 360px phone test + fresh-sympy oracle (54/54 claims true). Re-derived by hand from the frames: secant readout (4−1)/(2−1)=3 ✓ shown at 17.25-19.5s; the difference quotient ((1+h)²−1)/h = 2+h is EXACT at every sampled readout — h 0.98/0.52/0.51/0.50/0.49/0.46/0.35/0.21/0.13/0.11/0.10/0.02/0.00 → slope 2.98/2.52/2.51/2.50/2.49/2.46/2.35/2.21/2.13/2.11/2.10/2.02/2.00 (verified pairs include the h=0.50 flash at t≈23.4 and the h=0.10 dwell at t≈24.2-25.0); tangent settles 2.00 at x=1, readout settles 4.00 at x=2 and 6.00 at x=3 with mid-sweep transients all exact (2.54=2+0.54, 2.86=2×1.43, 5.02=2×2.51); list rows 2/4/6 ✓; d/dx x²=2x, d/dx x³=3x², d/dx xⁿ=n xⁿ⁻¹ ✓ with the full expand/cancel chain shown on screen (t≈40 x²+2xh+h²−x² → t≈41 2xh+h² → t≈43 2x+h → t≈44 lim → 2x); line geometry matches the equations (secant y=3x−2 crosses the axis at x≈0.67; tangents cross at 0.5/1/1.5 for x=1/2/3). Not correctness issues, but flagged: h=0.50 flashes for only ~0.2s with no dwell while "a half" is spoken over ~1s (h=0.10 dwells ~0.8s and lands perfectly) — sync asymmetry; amber results render upright roman with a wide gap ("2 x", "3 x²", "n xⁿ⁻¹") against italic math elsewhere; d/dx fraction bars are hairline-pale; "h → 0" grey violates the red=h brand rule; lim highlighted amber in s05 but black in s03. Non-issues confirmed: the {name}/{p1} tokens live only in sheet labels (SRT clean, no burned captions); the mid-write "doubled glyphs" are a deliberate stroke-then-fill ink reveal (~0.5s, clears fully); audio is continuous voice, no clipping (max −1.5dB), level drift ≤1dB. Verdict vs the 8+ bar: NOT passing — correctness 10, sound and clarity 8, but composition 6 and hook/readability/motion/variety/brand at 7. The math spine (secant→pivot→live readout→rule) is exemplary; the layout craft lags it.

problems.issue: The round-2 size fix only reached 9:16: the portrait slope/h readouts are now real digits (27px native = 18px at 360px, judged 9/10 at true phone size) but in 16:9 they still render ~6px at 360px (17px native at 960x540; judges 3-4/10, so 2.00 vs 2.02 stays indistinguishable at phone size). The kit instruments were bumped to FULL math size but tangent never calls them — every scene carries its own local live_readout at 0.8x math, and even full math would render only ~8px at 360px in 16:9. Ticks stay ~6px at 360px in both formats (3/10) and the landing h -> 0 is still grey, not the red h-color.
problems.fix: Make instrument size format-aware with a phone floor (>= 12px at 360px): in 16:9 scale the slope/h readouts and ticks to ~1.5-2x math (or route the scenes through the kit instruments); render h -> 0 in the red h-color at full weight; thicken the early secant.

problems.issue: The empty back half is untouched: s05 fades the graph out at 38.3s and runs 18.5s of stacked equations at ~85-90% empty canvas in both formats (measured 89-90% empty in 9:16 at 45.5s; near-blank moments at 38.5s and 56.5s mid-fade), and the s06 recap is ~65% empty with a top void of 43% of the portrait frame, misaligned left edges (formula x~70 vs text x~105) and a static hold for the last ~3s.
problems.fix: Keep a small live curve + tangent + slope-readout callback beside the s05 derivation and the s06 recap (the rule applied at x = 1/2/3); grow the EqSteps column to fill the stage; end on the pivot moment instead of a still; align the recap left edges.

problems.issue: The 9:16 plot proportion is unchanged: the lab is a wide 2:1 box at ~17-25% of frame height in every scene, with ~45% of the portrait height dead margins (a 300-415px empty top band frame after frame; 43% in s06) — the portrait frame is never re-proportioned, so the pivot, the spine of the film, plays small and low.
problems.fix: Give the 9:16 lab box ~40-50% of the portrait stage height (a taller plot, not just bigger type) and vertically center the title/plot/readout/work stack; keep the fixed readout HUD slot.

notes: round 3 by math-critic — re-derived secant (4-1)/(2-1) = 3; slope = 2+h EXACT at every sampled readout (3.00 -> 2.78 -> 2.50 -> 2.10 -> 2.02 -> 2.00 against h 1.00 -> 0.78 -> 0.50 -> 0.10 -> 0.02 -> 0.00; the r2 denser series 2.98 -> 2.00 also all exact); tangent 2/4/6 at x = 1/2/3 with mid-sweep transients exact (2.86 = 2 x 1.43, 5.02 = 2 x 2.51); x^2 -> 2x, x^3 -> 3x^2, x^n -> n x^(n-1). check tangent: 6/6 scenes clean, independent fresh-sympy 54/54 claims true, gates ALL PASS — correctness 10. Fix audit vs r2: (1) readout size — FIXED in 9:16, the phone format (18px at 360px, real digits) but STILL a ~6px speck in 16:9: the kit full-math fix never reaches tangent because the scenes use their own 0.8x-math live_readout; (2) scene-seam reflows — the readout row is now a fixed HUD slot (verified: same pixel band at 23.5s and 33.5s) but work blocks still reflow at seams (20.5s stack swap, 46.5 -> 48.5s row shift, 56.5 -> 58.5s layout change); (3) empty canvas + 9:16 plot share — untouched (s05 89-90% empty in portrait, s06 65% with a 43% top void, plot 17-25% of portrait height, 16:9 55-70% empty with a dead bottom-right). Also persisting from r2: grey h -> 0, thin early secant, 3/10 ticks, the h=0.50 flash vs h=0.10 dwell asymmetry, the static recap tail. Verdict vs the 8+ bar: NOT passing — correctness 10, motion 8, but composition 5 and readability/brand at 7. The math spine (secant -> pivot -> live readout -> rule) is exemplary; the layout craft still lags it.
